title: Very cute items
text: Love the items. They give just the right amount of holiday spirit to not make you feel overwhelmed. I now have anew drink to try-The Mulled cider spices with instructions are easy to follow and will smell great while simmering.  The holiday scented reed diffuser makes my bathroom smell lovely!  Worth the money to invest in.  Can always save items to pass on as unique gifts.
label: positive
